data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'goēgos', meaning 'god's shepherd'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes the role of a spiritual leader or caretaker, guiding and protecting their flock. The name Goeger carries the meaning “God's shepherd” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Goeger usually hope their child will grow to embody god's shepherd and live with faith, good character and purpose.
